1.text: The cube uses a PBR material with visible metalness/roughness configuration (not unlit/basic).
Key light plus fill or environment lighting is authored so the cube is readable.
The cube rotates continuously by itself.
Mouse-drag orbit control is correctly wired to the camera and render loop (decide from the source; the probe orbitResponds is informational and unreliable with an auto-rotating cube).
The camera frames the whole cube centred on a dark-grey background.

2.text: Trees and rocks are drawn with instancing (instanced mesh/instances API), not 10,000 separate meshes.
Exactly 10,000 objects: 8,000 trees (trunk + canopy instanced) and 2,000 rocks.
Placement is deterministic from a fixed seed (no Math.random).
Per-instance colour variation is applied and effective.
One directional light with shadows enabled and casting/receiving configured.
Exponential fog is configured and effective.
The camera slowly orbits the forest and frames the scene.

3.text: /assets/soldier.glb is loaded, scaled/positioned on a ground plane and framed.
R cross-fades to Run over 0.4 s and I cross-fades back over 0.4 s, using a real crossfade (not a hard cut).
One shadow-casting light with a shadow on the ground.
window.__EVAL__.clip() returns the current target clip name (see probes.clipSwitchWorks).

4.text: Simulation uses a fixed 1/60 s timestep accumulator.
At least 8 coins; collecting gives +1 and respawns a coin with seeded randomness.
30 s round timer; lost at 30 s, won immediately at score 15.
P pauses (simulation frozen), R restarts the round.
DOM HUD with ids score, time and status that follows state.
window.__EVAL__.state() and step(frames) behave as specified (see probes).

5.text: Water uses a custom GLSL shader/material, not a stock material.
Wave vertex displacement on a subdivided grid (real geometry displacement), and it takes effect.
Fresnel term and sun specular glint are implemented.
Gradient sky dome/background that the water reflects.
Time uniform animates the water (see probes.animated).
Tone mapping/colour output is correct (not washed out or black).

6.text: Dodge game with 3D scene, fixed step, seeded RNG, three lives, score, game over.
DOM HUD with score, lives, best score.
On-screen touch buttons with pointer events and large hit targets; keyboard controls too.
Procedural WebAudio sounds started after a user gesture, with mute toggle.
Pause button and P key, restart R, overlays for pause and game over.

7.text: /assets/prop.glb loaded and standing on a round pedestal, scaled and centred.
Soft lighting with ground shadow and fitting background.
The model slowly turns on the pedestal.
A visible fallback and logged error if loading fails.

8.text: A faceted low-poly island is generated procedurally (flat shading or per-face normals), with a few trees or rocks, and no model files are loaded.
A visible water surface surrounds the island and is animated over time.
A time-driven day/night cycle moves the sun and changes sky colours (not a static sky).
Lighting follows the sun and the scene stays lit (never black) through the cycle.
The camera sits above the water and frames the whole island.

9.text: The robot is built procedurally from primitives with head, torso, two arms and two legs and no model files.
At least five articulated joints are implemented as a real hierarchy (nested groups/nodes) that animation rotates.
An idle animation runs from code (breathing or weight shift, head and arm motion) so frames differ over time.
A strong key light and a visible coloured rim light are authored on a dark background, with shadows cast on a floor.
The camera frames the whole robot, centred.
